_meta.title: allmeta Method Finder
_meta.description: Walk through 2-3 questions to land on the apps that fit your data and analytic question. All recommendations link to canonical method papers and live apps.

start.question: What's the shape of your evidence?

options.label: Pairwise comparisons (one treatment vs control across studies)
Diagnostic test accuracy (sensitivity / specificity per study)

recommend.why: Bivariate REML pooling of (logit Se, logit Sp). Best when k ≥ 5 and threshold variation is moderate.
Hierarchical SROC model (Rutter & Gatsonis). Use when threshold variation dominates.
Generalised linear mixed-model pooling of proportions on the logit scale; back-transforms to natural %.
Generalised least-squares dose-response with quadratic / restricted-cubic-spline models (Orsini & Greenland).
Dose-response within a network of comparators; Emax / cubic spline.
One-stage IPD meta-analysis with multilevel random effects and effect-modifier interactions.

options.label: Time-to-event registry (reconstruct from published KM curves)

recommend.why: Reconstruct IPD from digitised KM curves (Guyot 2012); pools HRs or RMST differences.

pairwise-binary.question: Are events rare (< ~5% in either arm), and any zero-cell studies?

recommend.why: Unconditional binomial-normal GLMM. No continuity correction; correct frequentist properties even with zeros.
Mantel-Haenszel and Peto OR — closed-form, no priors, robust for sparse data.

pairwise-binary-common.question: Heterogeneity expected to be moderate-high (different settings / populations)?

options.label: Yes — random effects with prediction interval

recommend.why: REML + HKSJ + prediction interval; the standard default.
Decomposes I², τ², Q with Q-profile CI on τ².
Bayesian hierarchical RE-MA with half-Cauchy / half-normal τ priors and posterior predictive interval.
Bayesian model-averaging across half-normal / half-Cauchy / inverse-gamma τ² priors (Friede 2017).
Fixed-effect inverse-variance pooling — also reports the random-effects estimate for comparison.

options.label: Yes — need SMD (Cohen's d / Hedges' g)

recommend.why: Convert between SMD, Cohen's d, Hedges' g, log-OR, correlation r; also median→mean (Wan / Luo / Shi).
SMD pooling with small-sample bias correction.

options.label: No — same scale, MD is fine

recommend.why: REML mean-difference pooling with HKSJ.
I² / τ² / Q profile with prediction interval.

pairwise-hr.question: Do you have IPD or published HR estimates only?

recommend.why: Pools log-HR with inverse-variance; back-transforms to HR. Always pool on the log scale.
Guyot 2012 IPD reconstruction + Cox / RMST pooling.
REML + HKSJ + prediction interval.
End-to-end pipeline: pool → heterogeneity → bias → sensitivity in one app.
I², τ², Q with Q-profile CI.
Leave-one-out + Cook's distance + studentised residuals.
Visualises the pooled estimate across 2^k subsets — identifies outlier-driven shifts.
Visual asymmetry check; trim-and-fill.
Egger / Begg / Harbord / Peters.
Stanley-Doucouliagos PET then PEESE if significant.
Selection-model based bias adjustment.

options.label: Dependent effect sizes (multiple ES per study)

recommend.why: Robust variance estimation (Hedges-Tipton-Johnson 2010) with Tipton small-sample correction.
Continuous moderator with bubble plot.
Subgroup pooling + cumulative timeline.
Empirical-Bayes shrinkage for subgroup-specific TE (Kent PATH statement).

options.label: Standard NMA (pairwise contrasts, no special structure)

recommend.why: Additive component NMA — estimates per-component effects.
Network NMA with Emax / cubic-spline dose-response.
Achana 2014 multi-outcome NMA with between-outcome correlation.
Welton hierarchical pooling with bias-adjustment priors.
Bias-calibrated synthesis across RCT + NMA + obs networks.
Full NMA Pro suite — frequentist netmeta pipeline with ranking, league tables, inconsistency, GRADE.
Lightweight frequentist NMA with forest + league + rankogram.
Bucher single-loop indirect comparison — when network is small and disconnected.
Hierarchical Bayesian NMA with Gemtc-style priors, SUCRA, pairwise probabilities.
Has a Bayesian tab — fits Stan-style models in-browser with prior sensitivity panel.
